title: OWED (blocked-on-slot): the CLIPSeg empty-mask graph defect was never fixed -- it left the board by AUTO-CLOSE during a render drought
evidence: Class (a) of the old render-execution-error entry: job 7563 (2026-09-21 11:16Z) died inside the workflow with 'index is out of bounds for dimension with size 0' at the WAS 'Bounded Image Crop with Mask' node, because an EMPTY CLIPSeg head/hand mask reached it. The probe's fresh-error reporter (24h window) is the right shape for a one-off node crash, but this pass it aged out with 'condition no longer reproduces' purely because ZERO renders ran in the window (last render attempt 07:01Z, refusals_12h=7) -- that is an absence with no interval coverage, not a repair. The DECISION from 09-22 03:5xZ stands and is unchanged: repair the stored graph in place via a rake task of the same shape as pipeline:prompt_safety (snapshot the stored comfy_workflow_json into ops/backups, guard the crop node against a zero-area mask, revert by restoring the column) -- blocked-on-slot, not blocked-on-idea, because the only verification is a render and a bad edit to the 75-node production graph risks the only publish path. CLOSURE CONDITION: the guard edit applied AND verified by a render (same prompt/seed as a pre-change render) that completes the CLIPSeg path and passes both gates.
